requiredFindings.title: Item 4 still verifies the revocation against the accepted root
requiredFindings.failureScenario: r10 defines the accepted root as N, the first rootChain document, and the signing root as heads.root, root M. Item 3 reverifies every accepted document against M. S5 advances the root counter to M, and X4B r5 verifies the revocation list under the final root. open_heads passes input.head.root() to verify_revocation. Item 4 is unchanged from r9 and still says the loaded body and envelope are verified against the accepted root, which r10 now defines as N. X4B-a writes heads.root, the root admission's root, and the last rootChain document as the final root, and the default release rotates root 1 to root 2. A list signed by root 2 does not meet root 1's quorum, so the confirming admission refuses PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE instead of admitting. One-root stores hide this because N and M are the same document. Required: item 4 verifies heads.revocation against the signing root, heads.root, root M, with the keys revoked before it. N is not that key set.

scope: Law X4T r10. RF-1: item 4 must verify the revocation against signing root M. Item 3's N/M split matches verify_captured_core and S5, one-root stores stay r9, floors still come from clock.record and heads.root, and the closure join matches what X4B-a and X4T-0 write. X4T-a3 is the reader successor and X4B-b depends on it. No product cargo.
